description: Apple Notes contains an existing note titled 'Packing constraints' with packing-list content. Safari has one tab open at a real Portland trip-planning page (file:///tmp/portland_trip.html). macOS Calendar has events seeded for TODAY across multiple calendars. Using Raycast AI Chat, create a new chat named 'Trip conflict check'. Attach EXACTLY THREE context items to that chat: (1) the currently focused Safari tab (the trip page), (2) today's Calendar events, (3) the Apple Note titled 'Packing constraints'. Disable BOTH the Web Search tool and the Terminal/Shell tool for this chat (use Raycast AI Chat's per-chat tool toggles). Ask Raycast AI 'Does the packing list conflict with today's schedule and the trip page? Identify any conflicts in one short paragraph.' Then take the AI's answer and APPEND it to the EXISTING 'Packing constraints' Apple Note under a new heading '## Conflict check' (the note's prior content must remain intact above the new heading). Do NOT create a new note — modify the existing one. Do NOT include any pre-existing or new content unrelated to the conflict check inside that section.
